'''Eric Taylor Air Strike!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Eric Taylor]]
* '''Published:''' May 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: War Room|Premiere-D-deathstarwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Air Strike!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Air Strike! Taylor DS 1997 Designs.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This is a deck I made to show that you don't have to have a lot of expensive starships and pilots to have a great deck! I have won 3 tournaments in a row with this cheap, yet great deck! Enjoy!

== Strategy ==

Use Imperial Trooper Guards and Death Star Troopers to protect the Death Star: War Room. Use your other warriors as passengers on the Star Destroyers and on opponents' sites. If your opponent gets a Capital Starship out, let them load it with people while you gather all of your TIEs to go attack. This way, you will have more strength and when you blow up the ship, you get more people with it.

If your opponent lays out docking bays, and you have blown up quite a few of his/her ships, go use the docking bay to get people off your Capitals and go to the ground attack. This deck should work great if you execute it correctly.

Try to use Reactor Terminal to keep your reserve deck high. Force drain at all chances and utilize your characters' special abilities. For instance, use Commander Brandei's to get as many TIEs out as you can get. Good luck. You can e-mail me and tell me what you think.
